panels.description: Counts after applying country / region / accessibility / detail_state filters.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  count(*) AS superchargers,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.properties->'upstream'->'detail' IS NOT NULL AND p.properties->'upstream'->'detail' <> 'null'::jsonb) AS with_detail,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE jsonb_typeof(p.properties->'pricebooks') = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(p.properties->'pricebooks') > 0) AS with_pricebooks,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE (p.properties->>'stall_count')::int > 0 AND (p.properties->>'max_power_kw')::int > 0) AS with_stall_and_power
FROM pois p
WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND p.category = 'supercharger'
  AND (${country:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR p.country::text IN (${country:sqlstring}))
  AND (${region_search:sqlstring} = '' OR p.region ILIKE '%' || ${region_search:sqlstring} || '%')
  AND (${accessibility:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR p.properties#>>'{upstream,index,supercharger_function,charging_accessibility}' IN (${accessibility:sqlstring}))
  AND (
    ${detail_state:sqlstring} = 'all'
    OR (${detail_state:sqlstring} = 'with_detail'        AND p.properties->'upstream'->'detail' IS NOT NULL AND p.properties->'upstream'->'detail' <> 'null'::jsonb)
    OR (${detail_state:sqlstring} = 'missing_detail'     AND NOT (p.properties->'upstream'->'detail' IS NOT NULL AND p.properties->'upstream'->'detail' <> 'null'::jsonb))
    OR (${detail_state:sqlstring} = 'with_pricebooks'    AND jsonb_typeof(p.properties->'pricebooks') = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(p.properties->'pricebooks') > 0)
    OR (${detail_state:sqlstring} = 'missing_pricebooks' AND NOT (jsonb_typeof(p.properties->'pricebooks') = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(p.properties->'pricebooks') > 0))
  );

targets.rawSql:
SELECT

  ST_Y(ST_Centroid(p.geom)) AS lat
FROM pois p
WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND p.category = 'supercharger'
  AND (${country:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR p.country::text IN (${country:sqlstring}))
  AND (${region_search:sqlstring} = '' OR p.region ILIKE '%' || ${region_search:sqlstring} || '%')
  AND (${accessibility:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR p.properties#>>'{upstream,index,supercharger_function,charging_accessibility}' IN (${accessibility:sqlstring}))
  AND (
    ${detail_state:sqlstring} = 'all'
    OR (${detail_state:sqlstring} = 'with_detail'        AND p.properties->'upstream'->'detail' IS NOT NULL AND p.properties->'upstream'->'detail' <> 'null'::jsonb)
    OR (${detail_state:sqlstring} = 'missing_detail'     AND NOT (p.properties->'upstream'->'detail' IS NOT NULL AND p.properties->'upstream'->'detail' <> 'null'::jsonb))
    OR (${detail_state:sqlstring} = 'with_pricebooks'    AND jsonb_typeof(p.properties->'pricebooks') = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(p.properties->'pricebooks') > 0)
    OR (${detail_state:sqlstring} = 'missing_pricebooks' AND NOT (jsonb_typeof(p.properties->'pricebooks') = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(p.properties->'pricebooks') > 0))

layers.name: Average TSLA kWh price by region

targets.rawSql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    (p.properties->'upstream'->'detail' IS NOT NULL AND p.properties->'upstream'->'detail' <> 'null'::jsonb) AS has_detail,
    (jsonb_typeof(p.properties->'pricebooks') = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(p.properties->'pricebooks') > 0) AS has_pricebooks,
    p.properties#>>'{upstream,index,supercharger_function,charging_accessibility}' AS charging_accessibility
  FROM pois p
  WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND p.category = 'supercharger'
    AND (${country:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR p.country::text IN (${country:sqlstring}))
    AND (${region_search:sqlstring} = '' OR p.region ILIKE '%' || ${region_search:sqlstring} || '%')
    AND (${accessibility:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR p.properties#>>'{upstream,index,supercharger_function,charging_accessibility}' IN (${accessibility:sqlstring}))
), scoped AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM filtered
  WHERE ${detail_state:sqlstring} = 'all'
     OR (${detail_state:sqlstring} = 'with_detail' AND has_detail)
     OR (${detail_state:sqlstring} = 'missing_detail' AND NOT has_detail)
     OR (${detail_state:sqlstring} = 'with_pricebooks' AND has_pricebooks)
     OR (${detail_state:sqlstring} = 'missing_pricebooks' AND NOT has_pricebooks)
), pricebook_rows AS (
  SELECT
    p.id,
    coalesce(nullif(p.country::text, ''), '(unknown)') AS country,
    coalesce(nullif(p.region, ''), '(unknown)') AS region,
    NULLIF(pricebook->>'currencyCode', '') AS currency,
    NULLIF(pricebook->>'rateBase', '')::numeric AS rate_base,
    ST_X(ST_Centroid(p.geom)) AS lng,
    ST_Y(ST_Centroid(p.geom)) AS lat
  FROM scoped p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
    CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p.properties->'pricebooks') = 'array' THEN p.properties->'pricebooks' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
  ) AS e(pricebook)
  WHERE pricebook->>'feeType' = 'CHARGING'
    AND pricebook->>'uom' = 'kwh'
    AND pricebook->>'vehicleMakeType' = 'TSLA'
    AND NULLIF(pricebook->>'currencyCode', '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(pricebook->>'rateBase', '') IS NOT NULL
), site_prices AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    country,
    region,
    currency,
    avg(rate_base) AS site_avg_price_per_kwh,
    min(rate_base) AS site_min_price_per_kwh,
    max(rate_base) AS site_max_price_per_kwh,
    max(lng) AS lng,
    max(lat) AS lat
  FROM pricebook_rows
  GROUP BY id, country, region, currency
)
SELECT
  country,
  region,
  currency,
  round(avg(site_avg_price_per_kwh), 3) AS avg_price_per_kwh,
  count(*) AS priced_superchargers,
  round(min(site_min_price_per_kwh), 3) AS min_price_per_kwh,
  round(max(site_max_price_per_kwh), 3) AS max_price_per_kwh,
  avg(lng) AS lng,
  avg(lat) AS lat
FROM site_prices
GROUP BY country, region, currency
ORDER BY avg_price_per_kwh DESC, priced_superchargers DESC, country ASC, region ASC;

panels.title: Average Charging Price By Region

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  p.id,
  p.name,
  p.source_id,
  p.region,
  p.country,
  (p.properties->'upstream'->'detail' IS NOT NULL AND p.properties->'upstream'->'detail' <> 'null'::jsonb) AS has_detail,
  (jsonb_typeof(p.properties->'pricebooks') = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(p.properties->'pricebooks') > 0) AS has_pricebooks,
  (p.properties->>'stall_count')::int AS stall_count,
  (p.properties->>'max_power_kw')::int AS max_power_kw,
  p.updated_at
FROM pois p
WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND p.category = 'supercharger'
  AND (${country:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR p.country::text IN (${country:sqlstring}))
  AND (${region_search:sqlstring} = '' OR p.region ILIKE '%' || ${region_search:sqlstring} || '%')
  AND (${accessibility:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR p.properties#>>'{upstream,index,supercharger_function,charging_accessibility}' IN (${accessibility:sqlstring}))
  AND (
    NOT (p.properties->'upstream'->'detail' IS NOT NULL AND p.properties->'upstream'->'detail' <> 'null'::jsonb)
    OR NOT (jsonb_typeof(p.properties->'pricebooks') = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(p.properties->'pricebooks') > 0)
    OR (p.properties->>'stall_count')::int = 0
    OR (p.properties->>'max_power_kw')::int = 0
  )
ORDER BY has_detail ASC, has_pricebooks ASC, p.updated_at ASC NULLS FIRST, p.name ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT
  coalesce(p.properties#>>'{upstream,index,supercharger_function,site_status}', '(unknown)') AS site_status,
  coalesce(p.properties#>>'{upstream,index,supercharger_function,project_status}', '(unknown)') AS project_status,
  coalesce(p.properties#>>'{upstream,index,supercharger_function,access_type}', '(unknown)') AS access_type,
  coalesce(p.properties#>>'{upstream,index,supercharger_function,charging_accessibility}', '(unknown)') AS charging_accessibility,
  count(*) AS superchargers,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.properties->'upstream'->'detail' IS NOT NULL AND p.properties->'upstream'->'detail' <> 'null'::jsonb) AS with_detail,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE jsonb_typeof(p.properties->'pricebooks') = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(p.properties->'pricebooks') > 0) AS with_pricebooks
FROM pois p
WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND p.category = 'supercharger'
  AND (${country:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR p.country::text IN (${country:sqlstring}))
  AND (${region_search:sqlstring} = '' OR p.region ILIKE '%' || ${region_search:sqlstring} || '%')
  AND (${accessibility:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR p.properties#>>'{upstream,index,supercharger_function,charging_accessibility}' IN (${accessibility:sqlstring}))
  AND (
    ${detail_state:sqlstring} = 'all'
    OR (${detail_state:sqlstring} = 'with_detail'        AND p.properties->'upstream'->'detail' IS NOT NULL AND p.properties->'upstream'->'detail' <> 'null'::jsonb)
    OR (${detail_state:sqlstring} = 'missing_detail'     AND NOT (p.properties->'upstream'->'detail' IS NOT NULL AND p.properties->'upstream'->'detail' <> 'null'::jsonb))
    OR (${detail_state:sqlstring} = 'with_pricebooks'    AND jsonb_typeof(p.properties->'pricebooks') = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(p.properties->'pricebooks') > 0)
    OR (${detail_state:sqlstring} = 'missing_pricebooks' AND NOT (jsonb_typeof(p.properties->'pricebooks') = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(p.properties->'pricebooks') > 0))
  )
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
ORDER BY superchargers DESC;

SELECT
  coalesce(nullif(p.country::text, ''), '(unknown)') AS country,
  coalesce(nullif(p.region, ''), '(unknown)') AS region,
  count(*) AS superchargers,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.properties->'upstream'->'detail' IS NOT NULL AND p.properties->'upstream'->'detail' <> 'null'::jsonb) AS with_detail,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE jsonb_typeof(p.properties->'pricebooks') = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(p.properties->'pricebooks') > 0) AS with_pricebooks,
  round(avg(NULLIF(p.properties->>'stall_count', '')::numeric), 1) AS avg_stalls,
  max((p.properties->>'max_power_kw')::int) AS max_power_kw
FROM pois p
WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND p.category = 'supercharger'
  AND (${country:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR p.country::text IN (${country:sqlstring}))
  AND (${region_search:sqlstring} = '' OR p.region ILIKE '%' || ${region_search:sqlstring} || '%')
  AND (${accessibility:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR p.properties#>>'{upstream,index,supercharger_function,charging_accessibility}' IN (${accessibility:sqlstring}))
  AND (
    ${detail_state:sqlstring} = 'all'
    OR (${detail_state:sqlstring} = 'with_detail'        AND p.properties->'upstream'->'detail' IS NOT NULL AND p.properties->'upstream'->'detail' <> 'null'::jsonb)
    OR (${detail_state:sqlstring} = 'missing_detail'     AND NOT (p.properties->'upstream'->'detail' IS NOT NULL AND p.properties->'upstream'->'detail' <> 'null'::jsonb))
    OR (${detail_state:sqlstring} = 'with_pricebooks'    AND jsonb_typeof(p.properties->'pricebooks') = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(p.properties->'pricebooks') > 0)
    OR (${detail_state:sqlstring} = 'missing_pricebooks' AND NOT (jsonb_typeof(p.properties->'pricebooks') = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(p.properties->'pricebooks') > 0))
  )
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY superchargers DESC, country ASC, region ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
  (p.properties->>'max_power_kw')::int AS max_power_kw,
  count(*) AS superchargers,
  min((p.properties->>'stall_count')::int) AS min_stalls,
  round(avg((p.properties->>'stall_count')::numeric), 1) AS avg_stalls,
  max((p.properties->>'stall_count')::int) AS max_stalls
FROM pois p
WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND p.category = 'supercharger'
  AND (${country:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR p.country::text IN (${country:sqlstring}))
  AND (${region_search:sqlstring} = '' OR p.region ILIKE '%' || ${region_search:sqlstring} || '%')
  AND (${accessibility:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR p.properties#>>'{upstream,index,supercharger_function,charging_accessibility}' IN (${accessibility:sqlstring}))
  AND (
    ${detail_state:sqlstring} = 'all'
    OR (${detail_state:sqlstring} = 'with_detail'        AND p.properties->'upstream'->'detail' IS NOT NULL AND p.properties->'upstream'->'detail' <> 'null'::jsonb)
    OR (${detail_state:sqlstring} = 'missing_detail'     AND NOT (p.properties->'upstream'->'detail' IS NOT NULL AND p.properties->'upstream'->'detail' <> 'null'::jsonb))
    OR (${detail_state:sqlstring} = 'with_pricebooks'    AND jsonb_typeof(p.properties->'pricebooks') = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(p.properties->'pricebooks') > 0)
    OR (${detail_state:sqlstring} = 'missing_pricebooks' AND NOT (jsonb_typeof(p.properties->'pricebooks') = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(p.properties->'pricebooks') > 0))
  )
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY max_power_kw DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT
  ir.source,
  ir.status,
  count(*) AS runs,
  max(ir.completed_at) AS latest_completed_at,
  now() - max(ir.completed_at) AS latest_completed_age,
  sum(ir.seen_count) AS seen_count_sum
FROM import_runs ir
WHERE ir.source = 'tesla-superchargers'
GROUP BY ir.source, ir.status
ORDER BY latest_completed_at DESC NULLS LAST;
